newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - FORT JAMES STARTED.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - FORT JAMES STARTED.

text.p: Merrill Lynch said Wednesday it started coverage of Fort James, the paper company arising from the merger of Fort Howard Corp and James River Corp, with an accumulate rating for the intermediate term and with a long-term buy.
-- Analyst Jim Brucculeri said his 1997 earnings estimate for Fort James was $1.90 per share and his 1998 estimate was $2.65 to $2.70 per share.
-- Brucculeri said he had rated Fort Howard as an accumulate intermediate term and a buy long term. He rated James River an intermediate-term neutral and a long-term accumulate.

-- Brucculeri said the merger was complementary, as James River had a strong presence in consumer tissues in the United States and Europe, while Fort Howard had a good position in tissues away-from-home.
-- He said there was upside to 1998 earnings if the company could refinance some of Fort Howard's debt.
-- Fort James was set to start trading on the New York Stock Exchange on Thursday, he said.
